description: Tier-1 centerpiece for the Partner Dashboard: household name + member count and the combined net cash flow as one hero number. The only card that floats and the only card using typography.h1.

memberCount.description: Household member count; shown in the member badge

netCashFlow.description: Combined net cash flow (total_income - total_expenses); the hero number

totalIncome.description: Combined income; drives the 'in' half of the sub-caption

totalExpenses.description: Combined expenses; drives the 'out' half of the sub-caption

members.description: Up to 2 members for partner chips: [{ name, slot: 'A'|'B' }]; omitted -> chips hidden

mode.description: populated | empty (onboarding/new-household voice with CTA instead of hero)

onLinkAccount.description: CTA handler used only in empty mode

tokens.title: typography.h3 / colors.text
tokens.emptyChip: colors.info + information-circle icon, word SET UP

accessibility.label: {householdName}, {memberCount} members. Together this month, combined cash flow {sign} {amount}. {income} in, {expenses} out.
accessibility.colorIndependent: hero uses +/- prefix; empty uses icon + word SET UP (never color alone)
accessibility.reducedMotion: no essential motion; any draw-in uses animation.fast, instant under reduce-motion
